coordination_rules: Each repository remains authoritative for its own implementation state.
Universal AI Behavior may define reusable behavior but does not silently mutate consuming projects.
UARS returns research evidence and implementation knowledge but does not grant project authority.
powershell-connection may relay local work and analyze conversation data only through authorized supported sources.
Before cross-repository changes, resolve repository, branch, file, version, and authority.
Do not duplicate shared capabilities when an approved shared subsystem already exists.
